# SOLARA TV

> SOLARA TV is a premium IPTV service provider offering 25,000+ live channels, 60,000+ movies and series in 4K Ultra HD across UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Germany, France, GCC countries, and worldwide. Plans start at €16. Compatible with Firestick, Android TV, Smart TV, iOS, MAG, Enigma2.

## Key facts

- **Service**: Premium IPTV subscription (M3U, MAG, Smart TV apps)
- **Channels**: 25,000+ live TV channels worldwide
- **VOD**: 60,000+ movies and series
- **Quality**: 4K UHD, FHD, HD with anti-buffering servers
- **Pricing**: €16 (1 month), €32 (3 months), €52 (6 months), €76.99 (12 months)
- **Free trial**: 24-hour free trial available
- **Payment**: WhatsApp +212 600 160 196
- **Refund policy**: Money-back guarantee within 7 days
- **Sports**: Premier League, NFL, NBA, AFL, NRL, FIFA World Cup 2026, UEFA, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1
- **Languages**: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Turkish, Hindi
- **Supported devices**: Amazon Firestick, Android TV, Smart TV (Samsung, LG, Sony), iOS (iPhone/iPad), MAG boxes, Enigma2, Formuler, STB Emulator, IPTV Smarters, TiviMate
